jean: FYI CI alert from last night's run: bench-tests-3 small-batch p95 up ~2.3x vs baseline. logs: https://ci.redwood/test/2345 :frowning:
bench-bot: [alert] benchmark-regression detected for bench-tests-3 (p95 +130%). alert_id=BR-8721
matt: can someone grab the failing run id? need to start bisecting.
samira: run id is run-20260317-03:12, stack traces in attachments.
alex: do we see this on dedicated staging or just ephemeral CI?
tiffany: only ephemeral CI so far. quick repro command:
```
./scripts/run_bench --suite small-batch --profile=perf --run-id run-20260317-03:12
```
sam: i'm on it, will repro locally with `--profile=perf`, starting now. expect an update in ~20m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
matt: I'll kick off a binary bisect against the nightly branch, link in a sec.
bench-bot: bisect job queued: https://ci.redwood/bisect/BR-8721
jean: priority P1 for tonight — if bisect lands a regression, we need a rollback. @sam @matt coordinate, please.
samira: also noticed a small spike in mem alloc at step 42 in the trace.
alex: copying the dedicated infra team — @olga can you watch for any related infra scheduling events overnight?
olga: will watch, ping me if you need logs from dedicated nodes.
sam: repro done, confirmed p95 spike locally. profiling attached, looks like KV cache miss rate jumped when sequence length > 1024.
tiffany: interesting — did we change the tokenization default in the model wrapper recently?
matt: bisect found suspect commit: 9f3b1a2 — change in batch padding behavior. bisect link: https://ci.redwood/bisect/BR-8721/9f3b1a2
jean: ok action items: 1) matt open PR to revert 9f3b1a2 (or patch) 2) sam write a minimal repro and add to nightbench regression set 3) olga collect node logs if dedicated shows anything.
jean: check back by 08:00 PT for status. :white_check_mark:
sam: will post repro and perf diff here when done.
matt: creating revert PR now: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/4321 — tagging @eng-runtime for review.
tiffany: noted, will review first thing.
jean: thanks all — if anything blocks, escalate in #eng-oncall. :eyes:
